title: ShoppingListItemRow
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListItemRow.swift` — the item row rendered inside each aisle section. Leading: tappable circular checkbox (`circle` / `checkmark.circle.fill`) calling `ShoppingList.toggle(itemAt:)`, persisted immediately. Centre: item text via SwiftUI `Text` markdown rendering, strikethrough and `.secondary` foreground when checked. Trailing: decorative `line.3.horizontal` drag handle (no gesture, no-op). Swipe-to-delete (red `.swipeActions` button, calls `removeItem(atLine:)`). Swipe-to-edit (gray button, presents `.alert` prefilled with current text; on Save calls `updateItem(atLine:newText:)`). All icon-only controls carry accessibility labels.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping the checkbox calls `ShoppingList.toggle(itemAt:)` and the mutation is persisted to disk
Checked items render with strikethrough and `.secondary` foreground colour
`line.3.horizontal` drag handle is visible but has no attached gesture (decorative only)
Right-to-left swipe reveals a red "Delete" button and a gray "Edit" button
Delete button calls `removeItem(atLine:)` with no confirmation dialog
Edit button presents `.alert` prefilled with the item's current text; Save calls `updateItem(atLine:newText:)`
Cancel on the edit alert leaves the item unchanged
Accessibility labels present on checkbox, delete, and edit actions
